label: The Ephor's Crown

teams.notes: THE BOLD OPENER, AGAIN — heavy hitters first while Round 1 is soft. Inferno Rider and Forbidden Bastion killed and the Crownless carved to 60.48% on Aero Erosion's wall-to-wall +25%. Chisa's ONLY vigor this phase spent at slot one. New opener record: 10318 → 11210.

PLAN A, THE ORIGINAL DOSSIER — his pick over the Tune Break variant. Crownless finished, Calamity Effigy killed, R1 Matrix Mimic KILLED (1.1x points + 1000 bounty), and a bite of the R2 Inferno Rider (62.35%) before the clock ran out. Denia's only vigor. Best row of the cycle.

Echo Skill +40% on two bonus-DMG units. Sent at the R2 Rider and Bastion on purpose — Havoc is unwalled on both and she bowed out before the Crownless. R2 Inferno Rider killed, Bastion carved to 60.95%. Round 2 bosses priced at roughly 9k points each, measured here.

The cost of Plan A — Denia went to Aemeath so Lynae subbed in, spending her phase-bonus vigor. R2 Bastion (+30% ATK) killed, Crownless carved to 76.14%. Under her 11322 debut, and Denia's absence is the likely reason.

S4 MATRIX DEBUT — bumped that morning off the free five-star. First take felt clunky at 7642; his polish pass found +745. Two bonus-DMG units under General. R2 Crownless killed, Effigy carved to 84.57%, and the 8-waves Cycle Task cleared.

FOXED — the fox's first Matrix deployment, saved for the exact slot the board was built around: Electro Flare shut off the R2 Effigy's +40% ATK enrage, then the R2 Mimic gave her the 1.1x points. Effigy killed, Mimic carved to 40.62%. IRIDESCENT minted on her debut and the new debut record (11322 → 15737). Nyx is Electro Rover on this account.

The Mimic closer — the strongest General row went in for the R2 Mimic kill (1.1x + 1000 bounty) with Phoebe on her phase bonus. Mimic killed, Round 3 opened on a 99.33% Inferno Rider. Up 989 on her C5 row. Energy drink on the results screen.

BRANCH B, FOR SCIENCE — his hypothesis: Rebecca's heavy buff belongs on an all-heavies carry. Lucy/Rebecca/Mornye posted 7854 here first, then he hit Restart and ran this from the SAME 99.33% R3 Rider — +1710. Clean A/B, gut confirmed. R3 Inferno Rider carved to 52.03%.
THE MAGISTRATE BROKE THE RECORD — 92832 crossed the old 91723 with two rows still to play. Up 2773 on her C5 closer. Lynae and Shorekeeper on their second shifts. R3 Inferno Rider down to 19.13%.

OUTSIDE THE BOX — he benched Camellya and Changli so the last two rows could be the strongest two: Lucy (freed by Branch B) with Sanhua and Mornye's second shift, Tune Break because Mornye boosts it. R3 Inferno Rider killed, Bastion carved to 93.03%. Results screen put her on the moon again.

THE EPHOR KEEPS THE CROWN — needed 1890 for six digits and posted 11747 in Round 3, more than double her 5389 the last time Verina rode with her. His swap (Verina in, Changli out) and a Lv80 plant gremlin who doesn't need 90. R3 Bastion carved to 34.94%. 109857.

lessons: Six digits, day one: 109857 — +18134 (+19.8%) over C5's 91723. Every one of the eleven rows cleared 5k — the first board where nobody fell under.

Each boss walls exactly one element and nobody walls Electro or Spectro — the queue order IS the matchup control. Draft a pool, not a script: before each row, read which boss is up and send a team it doesn't wall.
Save the flex team for the enrage it switches off: the fox's Electro Flare disables the R2 Effigy's +40% ATK, and the R2 Mimic sat right behind it. Her debut (15737) was slot design, not luck.
Restart is a free A/B on the same boss state — Carlotta's polish pass (+745) and the Branch B test (+1710) were both his calls, and Branch B also freed Lucy and a Mornye shift for later rows.
The last rows are worth redrafting: benching Camellya and Changli to build Lucy/Sanhua/Mornye and Augusta/Iuno/Verina turned two ~3-5k slots into 5278 and 11747.
Unison buffs (Basic DMG card, Crownless's Unison clause) never fire for this fox — she runs the Electro Flare lane with Nyx, not a Unison partner. She takes Negative Status.
